column1: # Sovereignty star power (SOV-RES, #78): what a system's star adds to its hub's
# power budget. Authored by us, [A]: the client has a display band for it
# (orbitalSkyhook/resourceRichness.py [V]); ours is scaled to that band [I].
# Read by the server (`sov_resources::STARS`); edit and restart. The client
# reads star power once per session and the definitions version does not cover
# it, so a star edit needs a client restart.
# star_type_id: the catalogue's star type id, or 0 for every star type with no
# row of its own. power: added to the system's maximum power.

column3: [A] every star adds the same power, hundreds; falsifier: owner ruling that a star class matters
